{"version":"2b1","blocks":[{"type":"text","text":"International routes add 2 kg to the allowance. Gold adds 5 kg on either route. The fee is $15 per kg over the allowance and $0 at or below it."},{"type":"ui","source":"root = Stack([routeChoice, cabinChoice, statusChoice, weightChoice, allowanceResult, feeResult])
$route = 0
$cabin = 0
$gold = 1
$weight = 38
routeChoice = Control("Route", 0, 1, ["Domestic", "International"], $route)
cabinChoice = Control("Cabin", 0, 1, ["Economy", "Business"], $cabin)
statusChoice = Control("Gold status", 0, 1, ["No Gold", "Gold"], $gold)
weightChoice = Control("Bag weight (kg)", 10, 40, [], $weight)
base = $cabin == 0 ? 23 : 32
allowance = base + $gold * 5 + $route * 2
excess = $weight > allowance ? $weight - allowance : 0
allowanceResult = Metric("Bag allowance (kg)", allowance)
feeResult = Metric("Single-bag fee ($)", excess * 15)","state":[{"name":"route","value":0},{"name":"cabin","value":0},{"name":"gold","value":1},{"name":"weight","value":38}]}]}
